items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Oh yeah. He loves to tell that and no one could seem to tell it like him.

ctx.x: Well Jake Hanna made up, he tells a story about you making this weird entrance—

Oh yeah. He loves to tell that and no one could seem to tell it like him. We were playing at the Maryland Hotel in Chicago. And he builds up the story, he says, “And now, ladies and gentlemen, Buddy Rich, the world’s greatest drummer.” It’s pitch black. And then he says, “And guess what happens” he says I’m late for the stage, and he says, “and here comes Sam running to get on the stage on time.” “Now the world’s greatest drummer.” I knock over his cymbals and the whole bass drum and everything falls to the…
Is there any truth to it?
